decision.reasoning_trace: I started by filtering the feed for actual Bluetooth speakers, as several items were accessories such as cases, chargers, and replacement batteries. My consideration set includes a mix of high-end, mid-range, and budget options with relatively strong ratings. I included the JBL Charge 5 and UE MEGABLAST as premium/performance options, the Altec Lansing Mini H2O for its extreme portability and high rating, the TENMIYA for a bass-focused boombox style, and the Jabra Speak 410 for a professional speakerphone use-case. Ultimately, the JBL Charge 5 is the most compelling purchase because it has a near-perfect rating of 4.8 from a very large pool of reviewers, offering the best combination of sound quality, durability, and brand reliability for its price point.
